numbering: Episodes numbered continuously across all five seasons, 1-61, with the 2017 OVA counted as episode 25 (Wikipedia overall numbering).

arcs.name: Joining the Agency
arcs.summary: Starving orphan Atsushi Nakajima saves a man trying to drown himself, who turns out to be Osamu Dazai of the Armed Detective Agency. Atsushi soon learns the man-eating tiger plaguing Yokohama has a link to him.
events: Atsushi discovers he is the white tiger, thanks to his own ability.
A staged bombing serves as Atsushi's entrance test for the Agency.

arcs.name: Bounty on the Tiger
arcs.summary: The Port Mafia puts a huge price on Atsushi's head, while Atsushi tries to find his footing as a detective.
events: The Port Mafia's Ryunosuke Akutagawa ambushes Atsushi.
Atsushi learns a mysterious buyer has put a 7-billion-yen bounty on him.
Ranpo solves a murder case with Atsushi tagging along.

arcs.name: The Azure King
arcs.summary: A bombing case connected to the terrorist known as the Azure King pulls in the idealistic Kunikida.
events: Kunikida investigates the Azure King's attacks.
The case forces Kunikida to confront the cost of his ideals.

arcs.name: Kyouka and Rashomon
arcs.summary: A young Port Mafia assassin, Kyouka Izumi, crosses paths with Atsushi as the Mafia makes its move to capture him.
events: Atsushi tries to rescue Kyouka from the Mafia's control.
Atsushi and Akutagawa fight aboard a Mafia ship.
Atsushi defeats Akutagawa.

arcs.name: The Guild Arrives
arcs.summary: After some lighter Agency stories, a wealthy American organization with its own ability users sets its sights on Yokohama.
events: The Guild's leader Francis Fitzgerald arrives seeking the Agency's operating license.
The Guild makes clear it is also after Atsushi.

arcs.name: The Dark Era
arcs.summary: A flashback to four years earlier, when Dazai was a Port Mafia executive and drank with his friends Oda Sakunosuke and Ango Sakaguchi.
events: A rogue group called Mimic begins provoking the Port Mafia.
Ango is revealed to be a government spy.
Oda dies fighting Mimic's leader, setting Dazai on the path to leave the Mafia.

arcs.name: The Guild War
arcs.summary: The Agency, the Port Mafia and the Guild clash in a three-way war over Yokohama.
events: The Guild unleashes Kyusaku Yumeno's curse ability across the city.
Dazai and Chuuya reunite as the duo 'Double Black' to defeat Lovecraft.
Ranpo is trapped inside Poe's mystery novel.
Atsushi and Akutagawa team up to beat Fitzgerald and bring down the flying whale Moby Dick.

arcs.name: Walking Alone
arcs.summary: A standalone OVA episode released with the 13th manga volume.
events: A short side story set after the Guild war.
It was bundled with the manga's 13th volume instead of being broadcast.

arcs.name: Fifteen
arcs.summary: A flashback to Dazai and Chuuya's first meeting as fifteen-year-olds, investigating rumors of a dead Mafia boss's return.
events: Dazai and Chuuya are forced into an uneasy partnership.
The mystery of the god-like Arahabaki ties into Chuuya's origins.
Chuuya joins the Port Mafia.

arcs.name: Rats in the House of the Dead
arcs.summary: In the Guild war's aftermath, a new enemy led by Fyodor Dostoevsky begins working in the shadows.
events: Kyouka's future is threatened by her past crimes.
A disgraced Fitzgerald starts rebuilding his fortune.
A flashback reveals Fukuzawa's past as a skilled assassin.

arcs.name: Cannibalism
arcs.summary: Dostoevsky engineers a crisis that turns the Agency and the Port Mafia against each other again.
events: An ability infects Fukuzawa and Mori, and both will die unless one kills the other.
Fukuzawa and Mori come to blows before the scheme is broken.
Dostoevsky is taken into custody.

arcs.name: Founding of the Detective Agency
arcs.summary: A flashback to how Yukichi Fukuzawa met the young Ranpo Edogawa and founded the Armed Detective Agency.
events: Fukuzawa, a lone bodyguard, is hired to watch over Ranpo.
Ranpo's deductive genius is first put to the test.
The Agency is born.

arcs.name: The Decay of Angel
arcs.summary: The terrorist group Decay of Angel frames the Agency for murder, and the elite military unit Hunting Dogs is sent after them.
events: Mushitaro Oguri's 'perfect murders' make the Agency public enemies.
The Hunting Dogs hunt the scattered Agency members.
Dazai and Dostoevsky face off from inside the Meursault prison.
Atsushi infiltrates the floating Sky Casino in search of a way to clear the Agency's name.

arcs.name: Fukuchi's Endgame
arcs.summary: The true leader of the Decay of Angel steps into the open as a vampire plague spreads across the world.
events: Hunting Dogs captain Gen'ichiro Fukuchi, the Decay of Angel's true leader, moves openly toward his goal of uniting the world's militaries under one command.
A vampire outbreak spreads, turning people worldwide into Fukuchi's pawns.
Akutagawa falls in battle with Fukuchi.
Dazai and Dostoevsky's war of wits in Meursault reaches its end.

filler.note: No filler: every episode adapts the manga or its light novels.
